description.value:
Two weapons, or one weapon and one set of jaws. You and your Feral Bond both go for the throat at once.

SIGNATURE — reduced penalty when making a second attack against your Marked quarry the same turn.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Mark itself is now built (waywarden.mark-quarry.json grants TokenMark slug 'quarry'; target:mark:quarry is live). The remaining blocker is entirely this card's own text: real analog is Ranger's Flurry Hunter's-Edge classfeature (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/class-features/flurry.json) -- a pair of MultipleAttackPenalty rule elements (agile/non-agile, predicate target:mark:<slug>) that override the second- and third-attack MAP outright, e.g. Flurry's -3/-6 replacing the normal -5/-10. "Reduced penalty" here has no stated number to plug into that same pattern. Owner will supply the actual discount.
